verses.translation: Or he is born in a family of even the wisest of yogis; verily, such a birth is very difficult to obtain in this world.
verses.chTheme: Dhyana yoga — meditation and mind control

verses.translation: Then he comes into contact with the knowledge acquired in his former body and strives even more for perfection, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: Dhyana yoga — meditation and mind control

verses.translation: By that same former practice, he is borne on in spite of himself. Even he who merely wishes to know Yoga goes beyond the Brahmanic word.
verses.chTheme: Dhyana yoga — meditation and mind control

verses.translation: But the Yogi who strives assiduously, purified of sins and perfected gradually over many births, reaches the highest goal.
verses.chTheme: Dhyana yoga — meditation and mind control

verses.translation: The yogi is thought to be superior to the ascetics, even superior to those who have knowledge obtained through the study of scriptures; he is also superior to men of action; therefore, be thou a yogi, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: Dhyana yoga — meditation and mind control

verses.translation: And among all the Yogis, he who, full of faith and with his inner self merged in Me, worships Me is deemed by Me to be the most devoted.
verses.chTheme: Dhyana yoga — meditation and mind control

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, hear how you shall, without doubt, know Me fully, with your mind intent on Me, practicing Yoga and taking refuge in Me."
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: I will declare to you in full this knowledge combined with realization, after knowing which nothing else remains to be known here.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Among thousands of men, one may perchance strive for perfection; even among those successful strivers, only one may perchance know Me in essence.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and egoism—thus is My Nature divided eightfold.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: O mighty-armed Arjuna, this is the inferior Prakriti; know it as distinct from My higher Prakriti, the very life-element, by which this world is upheld.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Know that these two are the womb of all beings; thus, I am the source and dissolution of the whole universe.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: There is nothing higher than Me, O Arjuna. All this is strung on Me, like clusters of gems on a string.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: I am the flavor in water, O Arjuna; I am the light in the moon and the sun; I am the syllable Om in all the Vedas, sound in the ether and virility in men.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things
verses.theme: Krishna is the taste in water, the light in the sun and moon
verses.meaning: I am the taste of water, the light of the sun and the moon, the sound in space, the ability in humans and the fragrance in the earth. God as the essence of every beautiful thing. For someone who wants to sense the divine in ordinary life.

verses.translation: I am the sweet fragrance in the earth and the brilliance in the fire, the life in all beings, and I am the austerity of ascetics.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Know Me, O Arjuna, as the eternal seed of all beings; I am the intelligence of the intelligent, and the splendour of the splendid objects.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Of the strong, I am the strength devoid of desire and attachment, and in all beings, I am the desire in accordance with Dharma, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Whatever beings (and objects) that are pure, active, and inert, know that they proceed from Me. They are in Me, yet I am not in them.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Deluded by these Natures, composed of the three qualities of Nature, all this world does not know Me as distinct from them and immutable.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Verily, this divine illusion of Mine, composed of the three qualities, is difficult to cross over; those who take refuge in Me alone, can cross over this illusion.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things
verses.theme: My divine energy is difficult to overcome — but those who surrender to me cross it
verses.meaning: This divine energy of mine consisting of three modes is difficult to overcome. But those who have surrendered to me can easily cross beyond it. For someone who feels trapped by illusion, habit, or circumstance.

verses.translation: The evil-doers and the deluded, who are the lowest of men, do not seek Me; those whose knowledge is destroyed by illusion follow the ways of demons.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Four kinds of virtuous men worship Me, O Arjuna, and they are the distressed, the seekers of knowledge, the seekers of wealth, and the wise, O Lord of the Bharatas.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Of them, the wise who are ever steadfast and devoted to the One, excel; for I am exceedingly dear to the wise, and they are dear to Me.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Indeed, all these are noble; however, I consider the wise man as My very Self; for, he is steadfast in mind and established in Me alone as the supreme goal.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: At the end of many births, the wise man comes to Me, realizing that all this is Vaasudeva (the innermost Self); such a great soul (Mahatma) is very hard to find.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things
verses.theme: After many births the wise person surrenders knowing all is divine — very rare
verses.meaning: After many births and deaths, the person who is actually in knowledge surrenders to me, knowing me to be the cause of all causes. Such a great soul is very rare. For spiritual patience — the path is long and the seeker is rare.

verses.translation: Those whose wisdom has been taken away by this or that desire, go to other gods, following this or that rite, led by their own nature.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Whatever form any devotee desires to worship with faith, I make that same faith of his firm and unflinching.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Endowed with that faith, he engages in the worship of that form and obtains his desired outcome, which is ordained by Me alone.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Verily, the reward (fruit) that accrues to those men of small intelligence is finite. The worshippers of the gods go to them, whereas My devotees come to Me.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: The foolish think of Me, the Unmanifest, as having manifestation, not knowing My higher, immutable, and most excellent nature.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: I am not manifest to all, veiled as I am by the Yoga-Maya. This deluded world does not know Me, who am unborn and imperishable.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: I know, O Arjuna, the beings of the past, the present, and the future; however, no one knows Me.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: O Bharata, all beings are subject to delusion at birth due to the delusion of the pairs of opposites arising from desire and aversion, O Parantapa.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: But those men of virtuous deeds, whose sins have come to an end and who are freed from the delusion of the pairs of opposites, worship Me steadfastly, with their vows.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Those who strive for liberation from old age and death, taking refuge in Me, realize in full that Brahman, the whole knowledge of the Self, and all action.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Those who know Me with the Adhibhuta (pertaining to the elements), Adhidaiva (pertaining to the gods), and the Adhiyajna (pertaining to the sacrifice) know Me even at the time of death, remaining steadfast in mind.
verses.chTheme: Knowledge of the Absolute — God in all things

verses.translation: Arjuna said, "What is Brahman? What is Adhyatma? What is action, O best among men? What is Adhibhuta declared to be? And, what is Adhidaiva said to be?"
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: Who and how is Adhiyajna here in this body, O destroyer of Madhu? And how, at the time of death, are You to be known by the self-controlled?
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said, "Brahman is the Imperishable, the Supreme; its essential nature is called Self-knowledge; the offering (to the gods) that causes the existence and manifestation of beings and sustains them is called action."
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: Adhibhuta—knowledge of the elements—pertains to My perishable nature, and the Purusha, or the Soul, is the Adhidaiva; I alone am the Adhiyajna here in this body, O best among the embodied.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: And whoever, leaving their body, goes forth remembering Me alone at the time of death, they will attain My Being; there is no doubt about this.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death
verses.theme: Whoever leaves the body remembering me attains my nature
verses.meaning: Whoever at the time of death remembers me alone — leaving the body thinking of me — attains my nature. There is no doubt about this. For someone dealing with a dying loved one or contemplating mortality.

verses.translation: Whoever at the end leaves the body, thinking of any being, to that being only does he go, O son of Kunti (Arjuna), due to his constant thought of that being.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: Therefore, at all times, remember Me only and fight. With your mind and intellect fixed on Me, you will undoubtedly come to Me alone.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death
verses.theme: Remember me and fight — keep mind and intellect always fixed on me
verses.meaning: Therefore remember me always and fight. With mind and intellect surrendered to me — you will come to me without doubt. For someone who wants to bring spiritual awareness into their daily activity.

verses.translation: With the mind not moving towards any other thing, made steadfast through the practice of habitual meditation, and constantly meditating, one goes to the Supreme Person, the Resplendent, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: Whosoever meditates on the Omniscient, the Ancient, the Ruler of the whole world, minuter than an atom, the supporter of all, of inconceivable form, effulgent like the sun and beyond the darkness of ignorance.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: At the time of death, with an unwavering mind, endowed with devotion, by the power of Yoga, fixing the whole life-breath in the middle of the two eyebrows, he reaches that resplendent Supreme Person.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: That which is declared to be Imperishable by those who know the Vedas, that which the self-controlled (ascetics or Sannyasins) and passion-free enter, that goal, desiring which celibacy is practised, I will declare to thee in brief.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: Having closed all the gates, confined the mind in the heart, and fixed the life-breath in the head, engage in the practice of concentration.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: Uttering the one-syllabled Om, the Brahman, and remembering Me, he who departs, leaving the body, attains the Supreme Goal.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: I am easily attainable by that ever-steadfast yogi who constantly and daily remembers me for a long time, not thinking of anything else with a single-minded or one-pointed focus, O Partha.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: Having attained Me, these great souls do not take birth again here—a place of pain and impermanence—but have reached the highest perfection of liberation.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: All the worlds, including the world of Brahma, are subject to return again, O Arjuna; but he who reaches Me, O son of Kunti, has no rebirth.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: Those who know the day of Brahma, which lasts a thousand Yugas, and the night, which also lasts a thousand Yugas, know day and night.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: From the Unmanifested, all the manifested worlds proceed upon the arrival of the 'day'; upon the arrival of the 'night', they dissolve indeed into that which is known as the Unmanifested.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: This same multitude of beings, being born again and again, helplessly dissolves, O Arjuna, into the Unmanifested at the coming of the night and comes forth at the coming of the day.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: But verily, there exists higher than this Unmanifested, another Unmanifested Eternal, which is not destroyed even when all beings are destroyed.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: What is known as the Unmanifested and the Imperishable, That is said to be the highest goal. Those who reach It do not return (to this Samsara). That is My supreme abode (place or state).
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: That highest Purusha, O Arjuna, is attainable by unswerving devotion to Him alone, within Whom all beings dwell and by Whom all this is pervaded.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: Now I will tell you, O chief of the Bharatas, the times of departure at which the Yogis will return or not return.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: Fire, light, daytime, the bright fortnight, the six months of the northern path of the sun (the northern solstice) departing, then men who know Brahman go to Brahman.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: Attaining the lunar light through smoke, night time, the dark fortnight, and the six months of the southern path of the sun (the southern solstice), the yogi returns.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: The bright and dark paths of the world are thought to be eternal; one leads to no return, and the other leads to return.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: Knowing these paths, O Arjuna, no yogi is deluded; therefore, at all times, be steadfast in yoga.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: Whatever fruit of merit is declared (in the scriptures) to accrue from (the study of) the Vedas, (the performance of) sacrifices, (the practice of) austerities, and gifts, beyond all this goes the Yogi, having known this; and he attains to the Supreme, Primeval (first or ancient) Abode.
verses.chTheme: The imperishable Brahman — consciousness at death

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said, "I shall now declare to thee, who does not cavil, the greatest secret—the knowledge combined with experience (Self-realisation). Having known this, thou shalt be free from evil."
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: This is the royal science, the royal secret, the supreme purifier, realizable by direct intuitive knowledge, according to righteousness, very easy to perform and imperishable.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: Those who have no faith in this Dharma, O Parantapa, return to the path of this world without attaining Me.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: All of this world is pervaded by Me in My unmanifest aspect; all beings exist within Me, but I do not dwell within them.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: Nor do beings exist in Me (in reality); behold, My divine Yoga, which supports all beings, but does not dwell in them, is My Self, the efficient cause of beings.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: As the mighty wind, moving everywhere, always rests in the ether, so too, know that all beings rest in Me.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: All beings, O Arjuna, go into My Nature at the end of a Kalpa; I send them forth again at the beginning of the next Kalpa.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: Animating My Nature, I again and again send forth all this multitude of beings, helpless under the force of Nature.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: These acts do not bind Me, O Arjuna, sitting as one indifferent, unattached to those acts.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: Under Me, as supervisor, Nature produces the moving and the unmoving; therefore, O Arjuna, the world revolves.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: Fools disregard Me, clad in human form, not knowing My higher Being as the great Lord of all beings.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: They are possessed of the deceitful nature of demons and undivine beings, filled with vain hopes, vain actions, and vain knowledge that is senseless.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: But the great souls, O Arjuna, partaking of My divine nature, worship Me with a single-minded devotion, knowing Me as the imperishable source of all beings.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: Always glorifying Me, striving, firm in their vows, prostrating themselves before Me, they worship Me with steadfast devotion.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: Others also, sacrificing with the wisdom-sacrifice, worship Me, the All-Faced, as one, distinct, and manifold.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: I am Kratu; I am Yajna; I am the offering to the manes; I am the medicinal herbs and all plants; I am the Mantra; I am also the ghee or melted butter; I am the fire; I am the oblation.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: I am the father of this world, the mother, the dispenser of the fruits of actions, and the grandfather; the one thing to be known, the purifier, the sacred monosyllable (Om), and also the Rik, Sama, and Yajur Vedas.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: I am the goal, the supporter, the Lord, the witness, the abode, the shelter, the friend, the origin, the dissolution, the foundation, the treasure-house, and the imperishable seed.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: As the sun, I give heat; I withhold and send forth the rain; I am immortality and also death, existence and non-existence, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: The knowers of the three Vedas, the drinkers of Soma, purified of all sins, worshipping Me through sacrifices, pray for the way to heaven; they reach the holy world of the Lord of the gods and enjoy the divine pleasures of the gods in heaven.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: They, having enjoyed the vast heaven, enter the world of mortals when their merit is exhausted; thus abiding by the injunctions of the three (Vedas) and desiring objects of desires, they attain to the state of coming and going.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: For those men who worship Me alone, thinking of no one else, for those ever-united, I secure what they have not already possessed and preserve what they already possess.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace
verses.theme: To devoted worshippers I carry what they lack and preserve what they have
verses.meaning: To those who worship me with devotion, meditating on my transcendental form — I carry what they lack and preserve what they have. For someone who feels unsupported or that their needs are unmet.

verses.translation: Even those devotees who, endowed with faith, worship other gods, worship Me alone, O Arjuna, but by the wrong method.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: For I alone am the enjoyer and Lord of all sacrifices; but they do not know Me in reality, and thus they return to this mortal world.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: The worshippers of the gods go to them; the ancestor-worshippers go to the manes; the worshippers of the deities who preside over the elements go to them; but My devotees come to Me.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: Whoever offers Me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or a little water, that, so offered devotedly by the pure-minded, I accept.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace
verses.theme: A leaf, flower, fruit or water offered with devotion — I accept it
verses.meaning: If one offers me with love and devotion a leaf, a flower, fruit, or water — I will accept it. For someone who feels their prayers, efforts or spiritual practice are too small or insufficient.

verses.translation: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give, whatever austerity you practice, O Arjuna, do it as an offering to Me.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace
verses.theme: Whatever you do, eat, offer, give, undergo — do it as an offering to me
verses.meaning: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give away, whatever austerities you undergo — do it as an offering to me. For someone who wants to make their entire life a spiritual practice.

verses.translation: Thus, you shall be freed from the bonds of actions yielding good and evil fruits; with the mind steadfast in the Yoga of renunciation, and liberated, you shall come to Me.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: I am the same to all beings; there is none hateful or dear to Me; but those who worship Me with devotion are in Me, and I am also in them.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace
verses.theme: I am equally disposed to all — no one is favoured or envied
verses.meaning: I envy no one nor am I partial to anyone. I am equal to all. But whoever renders service to me in devotion — they are with me, and I am with them. For someone who feels God has abandoned or ignored them.

verses.translation: Even if the most sinful worships Me, with devotion to no one else, he should indeed be regarded as righteous, for he has rightly resolved.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: Soon he becomes righteous and attains eternal peace; O Arjuna, proclaim thou for certain that My devotee never perishes.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: For, taking refuge in Me, they who, O Arjuna, may be of a sinful birth—women, Vaisyas, and Sudras—attain the Supreme Goal.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: How much more easily, then, do Brahmins and devoted royal saints attain the goal? Having come to this impermanent and unhappy world, do thou worship Me.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: Fix your mind on Me; be devoted to Me; sacrifice to Me; bow down to Me; having thus united your whole self to Me, taking Me as the supreme goal, you will come to Me.
verses.chTheme: Royal knowledge — devotion and divine grace

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said, Again, O mighty-armed Arjuna, listen to my supreme word which I will declare to you, who are beloved, for your welfare.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Neither the hosts of the gods nor the great sages know My origin; for I am the source of all the gods and the great sages in every way.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: He who knows Me as unborn and beginningless, as the great Lord of the worlds, he among mortals is undeluded and is liberated from all sins.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Intellect, wisdom, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-restraint, calmness, happiness, pain, existence or birth, non-existence or death, fear, and also fearlessness.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Non-injury, equanimity, contentment, austerity, beneficence, fame, and ill-fame—these different qualities of beings arise from Me alone.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: The seven great sages, the ancient four, and the Manus, possessing powers like Mine (due to their minds being fixed on Me), were born from My mind; from them, these creatures have been born in this world.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: He who truly knows these manifold manifestations of My Being and this Yoga-power of Mine, becomes established in unshakable Yoga; there is no doubt about it.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: I am the source of all; from me everything evolves; Understanding this, the wise, endowed with meditation, worship me.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: With their minds and lives wholly absorbed in Me, they enlighten each other and ever speak of Me, being satisfied and delighted.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: To those who are ever steadfast, worshipping me with love, I give the yoga of discrimination, by which they come to me.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Out of mere compassion for them, I, dwelling within their selves, destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the luminous lamp of knowledge.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Arjuna said, "You are the Supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, the supreme purifier, eternal, divine Person, the primeval God, unborn, and omnipresent."
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: All the sages have thus declared Thee, as also the divine sage Narada; so also Asita, Devala, and Vyasa; and now Thou Thyself dost say so to me.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: I believe all that You have said to me to be true, O Krishna; indeed, O blessed Lord! Neither the gods nor the demons know Your manifestation (origin).
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Verily, Thou Thyself knowest Thyself by Thyself, O Supreme Person, O source and Lord of all beings, O God of gods, O ruler of the world!
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: You should indeed tell, without reserve, of your divine glories by which you exist, pervading all these worlds. (No one else can do so.)
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: How shall I, ever meditating, know you, O Yogin? In what aspects or things, O blessed Lord, should I think of you?
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Tell me again in detail, O Krishna, of your yogic power and glory; for I am not satiated with what I have heard of your life-giving and nectar-like speech.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said, "Very well! Now I will declare to you My divine glories in their prominence, O Arjuna; there is no end to their detailed description."
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: I am the Self, O Gudakesa, seated in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything
verses.theme: I am the Self seated in the heart of all beings
verses.meaning: I am the Self seated in the hearts of all living entities. I am the beginning, the middle and the end of all beings. For someone searching for God or connection outside themselves.

verses.translation: Among the twelve Adityas, I am Vishnu; among luminaries, the radiant sun; among the seven or forty-nine Maruts, I am Marichi; among stars, I am the moon.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Among the Vedas, I am the Sama-Veda; among the gods, I am Vasava; among the senses, I am the mind; and among living beings, I am intelligence.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: And among the Rudras, I am Sankara; among the Yakshas and Rakshasas, the Lord of Wealth (Kubera); among the Vasus, I am Pavaka (Fire); and among the seven mountains, I am Meru.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: And, among the household priests of kings, O Arjuna, know Me to be the chief, Brihaspati; among the army generals, I am Skanda; among lakes, I am the ocean.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Among the great sages, I am Bhrigu; among words, I am the one syllable (Om); among sacrifices, I am the sacrifice of silent repetition; among the immovable things, I am the Himalayas.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Among all the trees, I am the Peepul; among the divine sages, I am Narada; among the Gandharvas, I am Chitraratha; among the perfected, I am the sage Kapila.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Know Me as Ucchaisravas, born of nectar, among horses; Airavata among lordly elephants; and the king among men.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Among weapons, I am the thunderbolt; among cows, I am the wish-fulfilling cow called Kamadhenu; I am the progenitor, the god of love; among serpents, I am Vasuki.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: I am Ananta among the Nagas; I am Varuna among water-deities; Aryaman among the Manes; I am Yama among the governors.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: And I am Prahlada among the demons, I am Time among reckoners, I am the lion among beasts, and Vainateya (Garuda) among birds.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Among the purifiers, I am the wind; among the warriors, I am Rama; among the fishes, I am the shark; among the streams, I am the Ganga.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Among creations I am the beginning, the middle, and the end, O Arjuna; among the sciences, I am the science of the Self; and I am the logic among controversialists.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Among the letters of the alphabet, I am the letter 'A' and the dual among compounds. I am verily the inexhaustible and everlasting time; I am the dispenser of the fruits of actions, having faces in all directions.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: And I am the all-devouring Death, and the source of prosperity for those who are to be prosperous; among the feminine qualities, I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, firmness, and forgiveness.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Among the hymns, I am the Brihatsaman; among meters, I am Gayatri; among months, I am Margasirsha; among seasons, I am the flowery season.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: I am the gambling of the deceitful; I am the splendor of the splendid; I am victory; I am the resolve of the resolute; I am the goodness of the good.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Among the Vrishnis, I am Vaasudeva; among the Pandavas, I am Arjuna; among the sages, I am Vyasa; among the poets, I am Usanas, the poet.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Of those who punish, I am the scepter; among those who seek victory, I am statesmanship; and among secrets, I am silence; I am knowledge among knowers.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: And whatever is the seed of all beings, that too am I, O Arjuna; there is no being, be it moving or unmoving, that can exist without Me.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything
verses.theme: I am the generating seed of all existences
verses.meaning: Furthermore I am the generating seed of all existences. There is no being — moving or unmoving — that can exist without me. For someone questioning the source of meaning or existence.

verses.translation: There is no end to My divine glories, O Arjuna, but this is a brief statement by Me of the particulars of My divine glory.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Whatever being there is glorious, prosperous, or powerful, know that to be a manifestation of a part of My splendor.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything
verses.theme: Whatever is glorious, prosperous or powerful is a spark of my splendor
verses.meaning: Know that all beautiful, glorious and mighty creations spring from but a spark of my splendor. For someone who cannot see meaning or beauty in their life or the world.

verses.translation: But, of what avail is the knowledge of all these details to you, O Arjuna? I exist, supporting this whole world with one part of Myself.
verses.chTheme: Divine manifestations — God as the best of everything

verses.translation: Arjuna said, By this explanation of the highest secret concerning the Self which Thou hast spoken, for the sake of blessing me, my delusion has been dispelled.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: The origin and destruction of beings have been heard in detail from You, O lotus-eyed Lord, and also Your inexhaustible greatness.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Now, O Supreme Lord, as Thou hast thus described Thyself, O Supreme Person, I wish to behold Thy divine form.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: If Thou, O Lord, thinkest it possible for me to see it, do Thou, then, O Lord of the Yogis, show me Thy imperishable Self.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said, "Behold, O Arjuna, forms of Mine, by the hundreds and thousands, of different sorts, divine, and of various colors and shapes."
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Behold the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Asvins, and the Maruts; behold many wonders never before seen, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Now, behold, O Arjuna, in this My body, the entire universe centered in one, including the moving and the unmoving, and whatever else you desire to see.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: But you are not able to behold Me with these your own eyes; I give you the divine eye; behold My lordly Yoga.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken, O king, the great Lord of Yoga, Hari (Krishna), showed Arjuna His supreme form as the Lord.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: With numerous mouths and eyes, with numerous wondrous sights, with numerous divine adornments, with numerous divine weapons uplifted, such a form He showed.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Wearing divine garlands and apparel, anointed with divine unguents, the all-wonderful, resplendent Being is endless with faces on all sides.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: If the splendour of a thousand suns were to blaze out simultaneously in the sky, that would be the splendour of that mighty being.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: There, in the body of the God of gods, Arjuna then saw the entire universe resting in one, with its myriad of divisions.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Then, Arjuna, filled with wonder and his hair standing on end, bowed his head to the God and spoke with palms joined.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Arjuna said, "O God, I see all the gods in Your body, as well as hosts of various classes of beings, Brahma the Lord seated on the lotus, all the sages, and the celestial serpents."
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: I see You with boundless form on every side, with many arms, stomachs, mouths, and eyes; neither the end nor the middle nor the beginning do I see, O Lord of the Universe, O Cosmic Form.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: I see You with the diadem, club, and discus, a mass of radiance shining everywhere, very hard to look at, blazing all around like a burning fire and the sun, and immeasurable.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: You are the Imperishable, the Supreme Being, worthy of being known. You are the great treasure-house of this universe; You are the imperishable protector of the eternal Dharma; You are the Primal Person, I believe.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: I see You without beginning, middle, or end, infinite in power, with endless arms, the sun and moon as Your eyes, the burning fire Your mouth, heating the entire universe with Your radiance.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: This space between the earth and the heavens, and all the quarters, is filled by You alone; having seen this, Your wonderful and terrible form, the three worlds are trembling with fear, O great-souled Being.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Verily, these hosts of gods enter into Thee; some extol Thee with joined palms in fear, saying, 'May it be well!' Bands of great sages and perfected ones praise Thee with complete hymns.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: The Rudras, Adityas, Vasus, Sadhyas, Visvedevas, the two Asvins, Maruts, the Manus, and the hosts of celestial singers, Yakshas, demons, and the perfected ones, all look upon Thee with great amazement.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Having seen Your immeasurable form with many mouths and eyes, O mighty-armed one, with many arms, thighs, and feet, with many stomachs and fearsome with many teeth, the worlds are terrified, and so am I.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: On seeing Thee, touching the sky, shining in many colors, with mouths wide open, with large fiery eyes, I am terrified at heart and find neither courage nor peace, O Vishnu.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Having seen Thy mouths fearful with teeth blazing like the fires of cosmic dissolution, I know not the four quarters, nor do I find peace. Have mercy, O Lord of the gods, O abode of the universe.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: All the sons of Dhritarashtra, along with the hosts of kings of the earth, Bhishma, Drona, and Karna, as well as the chief among our warriors.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Some hurry into Your mouths with their terrible teeth, fearful to behold. Some are found stuck in the gaps between the teeth, their heads crushed to powder.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Verily, just as many torrents of rivers flow towards the ocean, so too these heroes in the world of men enter Thy flaming mouths.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: As moths hurriedly rush into a blazing fire, leading to their own destruction, so too these creatures hurry into Your mouths, leading to their own destruction.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Thou lickest up, devouring all the worlds on every side with Thy flaming mouths. Thy fierce rays, filling the whole world with radiance, burn, O Vishnu!
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Tell me, who you are, so fierce of form. I offer my salutations to you, O God Supreme; have mercy on me. I desire to know you, the original Being. I do not indeed know your workings.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said, "I am the full-grown, world-destroying Time, now engaged in destroying the worlds. Even without you, none of the warriors arrayed in the hostile armies will live."
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Therefore, stand up and obtain fame. Conquer the enemies and enjoy the unparalleled kingdom. Verily, by Me they have already been slain; be thou a mere instrument, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna
verses.theme: Arise — I have already slain them. You are merely the instrument
verses.meaning: Therefore arise and attain glory. Conquer your enemies and enjoy a flourishing kingdom. They are already put to death by my arrangement — be merely my instrument. For someone who has already done the work but cannot believe they can succeed.

verses.translation: Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna, and other brave warriors have already been slain by Me; do not be distressed with fear; fight and you shall conquer your enemies in battle.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Sanjaya said, Having heard that speech of Lord Krishna, Arjuna, with joined palms, trembling, prostrated himself, again addressing Krishna in a choked voice, bowing down, overwhelmed with fear.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Arjuna said, "It is fitting, O Krishna, that the world delights and rejoices in Your praise; demons fly in fear in all directions and the hosts of the perfected ones bow to You."
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: And why should they not, O great Soul, bow to Thee Who art greater than all else, the primal cause even of the Creator (Brahma), O Infinite Being, O Lord of the gods, O Abode of the universe; Thou art the imperishable, the Being, the non-being, and That which is supreme—that which is beyond the Being and the non-being.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: You are the primal God, the ancient Purusha, the supreme refuge of this universe, the knower, the knowable, and the supreme Abode. Through You, the universe is pervaded, O Being of infinite forms.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: You are Vayu, Yama, Agni, Varuna, the moon, the Creator, and the great-grandfather. I offer my salutations to You a thousand times, and again I offer my salutations to You.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Salutations to You in front and behind! Salutations to You on every side! O All! You, infinite in power and prowess, pervade all; therefore You are all.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Whatever I have presumptuously said from carelessness or love, addressing You as O Krishna! O Yadava! O Friend! regarding You merely as a friend, unknowing of Your greatness.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: In whatever way I may have insulted You for the sake of fun, while at play, reposing, sitting, or at meals, when alone (with You), O Krishna, or in company, that I implore You, immeasurable one, to forgive.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Thou art the Father of this world, both moving and unmoving. Thou art to be adored by this world; Thou, the greatest Guru; for none exists who is equal to Thee; how then could there be another superior to Thee in the three worlds, O Being of unrivaled power?
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Therefore, bowing down and prostrating my body, I crave Thy forgiveness, O adorable Lord. As a father forgives his son, a friend his dear friend, a lover his beloved, even so may Thou forgive me, O God.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: I am delighted, having seen something never seen before; yet my mind is distressed with fear. Show me that form only, O God; have mercy, O God of gods, O Abode of the universe.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: I desire to see You as before, crowned, bearing a mace, with the discus in hand, in Your former form only, having four arms, O thousand-armed, Cosmic Being.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, this Cosmic Form has graciously been shown to you by Me through My own Yogic power. It is full of splendour, primeval, and infinite; this Cosmic Form of Mine has never been seen before by anyone other than you."
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Neither by the study of the Vedas, nor by gifts, nor by sacrifices, nor by severe austerities, can I be seen in this form in the world of men by any other than yourself, O great hero of the Kurus (Arjuna).
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Do not be afraid, nor be bewildered on seeing such a terrible form of Mine; with your fear dispelled and with a gladdened heart, now behold again this former form of Mine.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken to Arjuna, Krishna again showed His own form. The great Soul, assuming His gentle form, then consoled Arjuna, who was terrified.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Arjuna said, "Having seen this Thy gentle human form, O Krishna, now I am composed and have been restored to my own nature."
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said, "It is very hard indeed to see this form of Mine which thou hast seen; even the gods are ever longing to behold it."
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Neither by the Vedas, nor by austerity, nor by gift, nor by sacrifice can I be seen in this form as thou hast seen Me so easily.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: But by single-minded devotion, I can be known, seen, and entered into in reality, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: He who does all actions for Me, who regards Me as the Supreme, who is devoted to Me, who is free from attachment, who bears no enmity towards any creature, he comes to Me, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: The universal cosmic form of Krishna

verses.translation: Arjuna said, "Which of them are better versed in Yoga—those who steadfastly worship You, or those who worship the imperishable and the unmanifested?"
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said, "In My opinion, those who fix their minds on Me, worship Me ever steadfastly, and are endowed with supreme faith, are the best in Yoga."
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion
verses.theme: Those who worship with steady devotion are most devoted
verses.meaning: Those who fix their minds on my personal form and who worship me with great and transcendental faith — I consider them to be most perfect. For someone deepening their spiritual practice.

verses.translation: Those who worship the imperishable, the indefinable, the unmanifest, the omnipresent, the unthinkable, the immovable, and the eternal.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: Having restrained all the senses, being even-minded everywhere, and intent on the welfare of all beings, they verily come unto Me.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: Greater is their trouble whose minds are set on the unmanifested, for the goal of the unmanifested is very hard for the embodied to reach.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: But to those who worship Me, renouncing all actions in Me, regarding Me as the supreme goal, meditating on Me with single-minded yoga.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: To those whose minds are set on Me, O Arjuna, verily I soon become the savior out of the ocean of Samsara.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: Fix your mind on Me, and your intellect in Me. Then you will certainly live in Me alone hereafter.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: If you are unable to fix your mind steadily on Me, then seek to reach Me through the yoga of constant practice, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: If you are unable to practice even this Abhyasa Yoga, be intent on doing actions for My sake; even by doing actions for My sake, you will attain perfection.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: If you are unable to do even this, then, resort to union with Me and renounce the fruits of all actions with self-control.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: Better indeed is knowledge than practice; better than knowledge is meditation; better than meditation is the renunciation of the fruits of actions: peace immediately follows renunciation.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: He who hates no creature, is friendly and compassionate to all, is free from attachment and egoism, is balanced in pleasure and pain, and is forgiving.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion
verses.theme: One who has no ill will toward any being, friendly and compassionate — is dear to me
verses.meaning: One who does not hate any creature, who is friendly and compassionate to all, free from false ego, and equal in pleasure and pain — is very dear to me. For resentment, hatred, or wanting revenge.

verses.translation: Ever content, steady in meditation, self-controlled, possessing firm conviction, with the mind and intellect dedicated to Me, he, My devotee, is dear to Me.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: He whom the world does not agitate, and who cannot be agitated by the world, and who is freed from joy, anger, fear, and anxiety—he is dear to Me.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion
verses.theme: One who does not disturb the world and is not disturbed by it — is dear to me
verses.meaning: One who does not disturb the world and is not disturbed by the world — who is steady in both joy and grief — is very dear to me. For someone absorbing toxic energy or being disturbed by others.

verses.translation: He who is free from wants, pure, expert, unconcerned, and free from pain, renouncing all undertakings and commencements, he who is devoted to Me is dear to Me.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves nor desires, renouncing both good and evil, and who is full of devotion, is dear to Me.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion
verses.theme: One who neither rejoices nor grieves, who neither laments nor desires — is dear to me
verses.meaning: One who neither rejoices, nor grieves, nor laments, nor desires — who renounces both auspicious and inauspicious things — is very dear to me. For emotional extremes and volatility.

verses.translation: He who is the same to foe and friend, and also in honor and dishonor, who is the same in cold and heat, in pleasure and pain, and who is free from attachment.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: He to whom censure and praise are equal, who is silent, content with anything, homeless, of a steady mind, and full of devotion; that man is dear to me.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: They who follow this immortal Dharma, endowed with faith and regarding Me as their supreme goal, are exceedingly dear to Me.
verses.chTheme: Bhakti yoga — the path of devotion

verses.translation: Arjuna said, "I wish to learn about Nature and the Spirit, the field and the knower of the field, knowledge and that which ought to be known, O Kesava."
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, this body is called the field; he who knows it is called the knower of the field by those who know them."
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Do thou also know Me as the knower of the field in all fields, O Arjuna. Knowledge of both the field and the knower of the field is considered by Me to be the knowledge.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Hear from Me in brief what the field is, of what nature it is, what its modifications are, whence it is, who He is, and what His powers are.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Sages have sung in many ways, with various distinctive chants and also with suggestive words indicative of the Absolute, full of reasoning and decisive.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: The great elements, egoism, intellect, and also the Unmanifested Nature, the ten senses, and one mind, and the five objects of the senses.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Desire, hatred, pleasure, pain, the aggregate (body), intelligence, and fortitude—the field has thus been briefly described with its modifications.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Humility, unpretentiousness, non-injury, forgiveness, uprightness, service to the teacher, purity, steadfastness, and self-control.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul
verses.theme: Humility, fearlessness, nonviolence — these are declared to be real knowledge
verses.meaning: Humility, fearlessness, nonviolence, tolerance, simplicity, approaching a spiritual teacher, cleanliness, steadiness, and self-control — all this is declared to be knowledge. For someone defining their values or character.

verses.translation: Indifference to the objects of the senses and also absence of egoism; perceiving the evil in birth, death, old age, sickness, and pain.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Non-attachment, non-identification of the Self with son, wife, home, and the rest, and constant even-mindedness in the face of the attainment of both desirable and undesirable.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Unswerving devotion to Me through the Yoga of non-separation, resorting to solitary places, and a distaste for the company of people.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Constancy in Self-knowledge, the perception of the end of true knowledge—this is declared to be knowledge, and what is opposed to it is ignorance.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: I will declare that which is to be known, knowing which one attains immortality; the beginningless Supreme Brahman, which is neither being nor non-being.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: With hands and feet everywhere, with eyes, heads, and mouths everywhere, with ears everywhere, He exists in the worlds, enveloping all.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Shining by the functions of all the senses, yet without being attached to them; unattached, yet supporting all; devoid of qualities, yet the experiencer of them.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: It is within and without all beings, both the unmoving and the moving; It is subtle and unknowable, and It is near and far away.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Undivided yet, It exists as if divided in beings; It is to be known as the supporter of beings; It devours and It generates.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: That Light of all lights is said to be beyond darkness: knowledge, the knowable, and the goal of knowledge, seated in the hearts of all.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Thus, the field, as well as knowledge and the knowable, have been briefly stated. My devotee, knowing this, enters into My being.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Know that Nature (matter) and the Spirit are both beginningless, and know also that all modifications and qualities are born from Nature.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: In the production of the effect and the cause, Nature (matter) is said to be the cause; in the experience of pleasure and pain, the soul is said to be the one responsible.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: The soul seated in Nature experiences the qualities born of Nature; attachment to the qualities is the cause of its birth in good and evil wombs.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: The Supreme Soul in this body is also called the observer, the permitter, the sustainer, the enjoyer, the great Lord, and the Supreme Self.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: He who thus knows the Spirit and Matter together with their qualities, in whatever condition he may be, he is not reborn.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Some behold the Self within themselves through meditation, others through the Yoga of knowledge, and still others through the Yoga of action.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Others, too, who do not know thus, worship, having heard of It from others; they, too, cross beyond death, regarding what they have heard as the supreme refuge.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Wherever a being is born, whether unmoving or moving, know thou, O best of the Bharatas (Arjuna), that it is from the union of the field and its knower.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: He who sees the Supreme Lord existing truly in all beings, the imperishable within the perishable, sees indeed.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul
verses.theme: One who sees the Supreme everywhere does not degrade the self
verses.meaning: One who sees the Supreme Lord equally present everywhere — does not degrade the self by the self, and thus attains the highest destination. For someone who wants to see the sacred in all things.

verses.translation: For he who truly sees the same Lord dwelling everywhere does not destroy the Self by the self; rather, he attains the highest goal.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: He sees, who sees that all actions are performed solely by Nature and that the Self is without action.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: When a person sees all beings as resting in the One and emanating from the One alone, they then become Brahman.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Being without beginning, devoid of any qualities, the Supreme Self, imperishable, though dwelling in the body, O Arjuna, neither acts nor is tainted.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: As the all-pervading ether is not tainted, due to its subtlety, so the Self seated everywhere in the body is not tainted either.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: Just as the one sun illuminates the entire world, so too does the Lord of the field (Supreme Self) illuminate the entire field, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: They who, by the eye of knowledge, perceive the distinction between the field and its knower, as well as the liberation from the Nature of being, go to the Supreme.
verses.chTheme: The field and the knower of the field — body vs soul

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said, "I will again declare to thee that supreme knowledge, the best of all knowledge, having known which all the sages have gone to supreme perfection after this life."
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: Those who, having taken refuge in this knowledge, have attained unity with Me, are neither born at the time of creation nor disturbed at the time of dissolution.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: My womb is the great Brahma; in it I place the germ; thence, O Arjuna, is the birth of all beings.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: Whatever forms are produced, O Arjuna, in any womb whatsoever, the great Brahma is their womb, and I am the seed-giving father.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: These qualities, O Arjuna, born of Nature, bind fast in the body of the embodied, the indestructible: purity, passion, and inertia.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance
verses.theme: The three modes — goodness, passion and ignorance — bind the soul
verses.meaning: Material nature consists of three modes — goodness, passion, and ignorance. When the eternal living entity comes in contact with these, it becomes conditioned by them. For self-understanding — why one behaves in certain patterns.

verses.translation: Of these, sattva, which is luminous and healthy due to its stainlessness, binds one by attachment to happiness and knowledge, O sinless one.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: Know, O Arjuna, that Rajas is of the nature of passion, the source of thirst and attachment; it binds fast the embodied one by attachment to action.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: But know thou Tamas to be born of ignorance, deluding all embodied beings; it binds fast, O Arjuna, through heedlessness, indolence, and sleep.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: Sattva attaches to happiness, Rajas to action, O Arjuna, while Tamas, verily shrouding knowledge, attaches to heedlessness.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: Now, O Arjuna, Sattva prevails, having overpowered Rajas and Tamas; then Rajas, having overpowered Sattva and Tamas; and then Tamas, having overpowered Sattva and Rajas.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: When the wisdom-light shines through every gate of this body, then it may be known that Sattva is predominant.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: Greed, activity, the undertaking of actions, restlessness, and longing—these arise when Rajas is predominant, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: Darkness, inertia, carelessness, and delusion—these arise when Tamas is predominant, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: If the embodied one meets death when Sattva is predominant, then they attain the spotless worlds of the knowers of the Highest.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: Meeting death in Rajas, he is born among those who are attached to action; and dying in Tamas, he is born in the womb of the thoughtless.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: They say that the fruit of good action is Sattvic and pure; indeed, the fruit of Rajas is pain, and the fruit of Tamas is ignorance.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: From Sattva arises knowledge, and greed from Rajas; heedlessness and delusion arise from Tamas, and also ignorance.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance
verses.theme: From goodness comes wisdom, from passion comes greed, from ignorance comes negligence
verses.meaning: From goodness comes wisdom. From passion comes greed. From ignorance come negligence, madness and illusion. Understanding where one's current state comes from.

verses.translation: Those seated in Sattva ascend; those of Rajasic nature dwell in the middle; and those of Tamasic nature, abiding in the function of the lowest Guna, descend.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: When the seer beholds no agent other than the Gunas and knows that which is higher than them, he attains to My Being.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: The embodied one, having crossed beyond these three Gunas from which the body is evolved, is freed from birth, death, decay, and pain, and attains immortality.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: Arjuna said, "What are the marks of one who has transcended the three qualities, O Lord? What is their conduct, and how do they go beyond these three qualities?"
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said, "When light, activity, and delusion are present, he does not hate them, nor does he long for them when they are absent.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance
verses.theme: The wise person is not disturbed when modes are active nor longs for them when absent
verses.meaning: The wise person who is not disturbed when the three modes are active — and who does not long for them when they are absent — is said to have gone beyond the modes. For ego-driven emotional swings.

verses.translation: He who, seated like one unconcerned, is not moved by the dualities, and who, knowing that the dualities are active, is self-centered and does not move.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: Who is the same in pleasure and pain, who dwells in the Self, to whom a clod of earth, a stone, and gold are all alike, who is the same to the dear and the unfriendly, who is firm, and to whom censure and praise are one and the same.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: Who is the same in honor and dishonor, the same to friend and foe, abandoning all undertakings, he is said to have transcended the dualities.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: And he who serves Me with unwavering devotion, he, crossing beyond the dualities, is fit for becoming Brahman.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: For I am the abode of Brahman, the immortal, immutable, and everlasting Dharma, and absolute bliss.
verses.chTheme: Three modes of material nature — goodness passion ignorance

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said: They (the wise) speak of the indestructible peepul tree, with its roots above and branches below, whose leaves are the meters or hymns; he who knows it is a knower of the Vedas.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: Its branches spread below and above, nourished by the Gunas; its buds are sense-objects, and its roots stretch forth below in the world of men, originating action.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: Its form is not perceived here as such, nor its end, origin, foundation, or resting place; having cut asunder this firmly rooted peepul tree with the strong axe of non-attachment.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: Then, that goal should be sought for, to which, having gone, none returns again. I seek refuge in that Primeval Purusha, from whence streamed forth the ancient activity or energy.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: Free from pride and delusion, victorious over the evil of attachment, dwelling constantly in the Self, their desires having completely turned away, freed from the pairs of opposites known as pleasure and pain, they, the undeluded, reach the eternal goal.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: Neither does the sun illuminate there, nor the moon, nor the fire; having gone there, they do not return; that is My supreme abode.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: An eternal portion of Myself having become a living soul in the world of life, draws to itself the five senses, with the mind as the sixth, abiding in Nature.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable
verses.theme: The living entities are fragments of the divine — carrying mind and senses
verses.meaning: The living entities in the material world are my eternal fragmental parts. Due to conditioned life, they struggle hard with the mind and six senses. For someone who feels disconnected or alone.

verses.translation: When the Lord, as the individual soul, obtains a body and when He leaves it, He takes these with Him, just as the wind takes the scents from their seats (flowers, etc.).
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: Presiding over the ears, eyes, touch, taste, smell, and mind, it enjoys the objects of the senses.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: The deluded do not see Him who departs, stays, and enjoys; but those who possess the eye of knowledge behold Him.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: The yogis striving for perfection behold Him dwelling in the Self; but, the unrefined and unintelligent, even though striving, do not see Him.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: That light which resides in the sun, illuminating the whole world; that which is in the moon and in the fire—know that light to be Mine.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: Permeating the earth, I support all beings with My energy; and having become the watery moon, I nourish all herbs.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: Having become the fire Vaisvanara, I abide in the bodies of living beings and, associated with the Prana and the Apana, digest the fourfold food.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: And I am seated in the hearts of all; from Me come memory and knowledge, as well as their absence. I am verily That which has to be known by all the Vedas; I am indeed the author of the Vedanta and the knower of the Vedas.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable
verses.theme: I am seated in the heart of everyone — I give memory, knowledge and forgetfulness
verses.meaning: I am seated in everyone's heart, and from me come remembrance, knowledge and forgetfulness. I alone am to be known by all the Vedas. For someone searching for inner guidance or connection to something deeper.

verses.translation: Two Purushas there are in this world: the perishable and the imperishable. All beings are perishable, and the Kutastha—the unchanging—is called the imperishable.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: But distinct is the Supreme Purusha, called the highest Self, indestructible and Lord, who pervades the three worlds and sustains them.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: As I transcend the perishable and am even higher than the imperishable, I am declared to be the highest Purusha in the world and in the Vedas.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: He who, undeluded, knows Me as the highest Purusha, he, knowing all, worships Me with his whole being (heart), O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: Thus, I have imparted to you this most secret science, O sinless one; by knowing this, one becomes wise, and all their duties are accomplished, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: The supreme person — beyond the perishable and imperishable

verses.translation: The Blessed Lord said: Fearlessness, purity of heart, steadfastness in knowledge and yoga, almsgiving, control of the senses, sacrifice, study of scriptures, austerity, and straightforwardness.
verses.chTheme: Divine and demoniac natures — virtue vs ego
verses.theme: Fearlessness, purity, perseverance in yoga — these are divine qualities
verses.meaning: Fearlessness, purification of existence, cultivation of spiritual knowledge, charity, control of the mind, straightforwardness — these are qualities of the divine nature. For someone working on their character.

verses.translation: Harmlessness, truth, absence of anger, renunciation, peacefulness, absence of crookedness, compassion for beings, non-covetousness, gentleness, modesty, and absence of fickleness.
verses.chTheme: Divine and demoniac natures — virtue vs ego

verses.translation: Vigor, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, absence of hatred, absence of pride—these belong to one born for a divine state, O Arjuna.
verses.chTheme: Divine and demoniac natures — virtue vs ego
verses.theme: Vigor, forgiveness, fortitude, purity — these are divine qualities
verses.meaning: Vigor, forgiveness, fortitude, cleanliness, freedom from envy and from the passion for honor — these belong to the divine nature. For someone struggling to forgive or cultivate inner strength.

verses.translation: Hypocrisy, arrogance, and self-conceit, anger, harshness, and ignorance—these belong to one who is born for a demoniacal state, O Partha.
verses.chTheme: Divine and demoniac natures — virtue vs ego

verses.translation: The divine nature is deemed conducive to liberation, and the demonic to bondage. Grieve not, O Arjuna, for you are born with divine endowments.
verses.chTheme: Divine and demoniac natures — virtue vs ego

verses.translation: There are two types of beings in this world: the divine and the demoniacal. The divine has been described at length; hear from Me, O Arjuna, about the demoniacal.
verses.chTheme: Divine and demoniac natures — virtue vs ego

verses.translation: The demoniacal do not know what to do and what to refrain from; they have neither purity, nor right conduct, nor truth.
verses.chTheme: Divine and demoniac natures — virtue vs ego

verses.translation: They say, "This universe is without truth, without a moral basis, without a God, brought about by mutual union, with lust as its cause; what else?"
verses.chTheme: Divine and demoniac natures — virtue vs ego
